## 320587: exact truncated-simplex extremal family

Write B(n,d,k)=2^(n-1)+sum(i=0..d-1) C(n-1,i)-sum(i=0..k-1) C(n-1,i). Fix x and take every set containing x of size at most n-k, together with every x-free set of size at most d-1. Thus the candidate has exactly B(n,d,k) elements, including the empty set once.

It is d-simplex-free. In any putative simplex A_0,...,A_d choose witness y_i in the intersection of all A_j with j!=i. Since total intersection is empty, y_i is absent from A_i. The witnesses are pairwise distinct: y_i=y_j would force that witness into A_i via its membership for index j. Each A_i therefore contains the other d witnesses and has size at least d. Consequently none can belong to the x-free small-set part. All contain x, contradicting empty total intersection. This pays construction/size for every permitted parameter, but not maximality or uniqueness. It is already the source proposed family, not a new family.
